title: RNA Extraction, cDNA Synthesis and qRT-PCR
author: Sophie Vacher
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kehctb6

steps.title: Extract Total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from breast specimens using the acid-phenol guanidium method (RNABLE, Eurobio) according to the supplier's protocol.

steps.title: Verify RNA Quality
steps.instruction: Determine the quality of the RNA samples via agarose gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Visualize 18S and 28S RNA bands under UV light.

steps.title: Perform cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Reverse transcribe RNA in a final volume of 20 μL containing specific reagents and template.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction mix with 1X RT buffer, 10mM of each dNTP, 20 units of rRNasinTM RNase inhibitor (Promega), 10 mM DTT, 100 units of Superscript II RNase H-reverse transcriptase (Life Technologies, Inc.), 0.15 µg/µL random primers (Life Technologies, Inc.), and 1 μg of total RNA.
Inactivate reverse transcriptase by heating at 99°C for 5 min.

steps.title: Perform qRT-PCR and Quantification
steps.instruction: Quantify target gene expression and the TBP endogenous control using the ABI Prism 7900 Sequence Detection System (Perkin-Elmer Applied Biosystems) and PE biosystems analysis software.

substeps.instruction: Determine the cycle number (Ct value) where fluorescence signal increase is detected.
Quantify TBP gene transcripts (Genbank accession NM_003194) as an endogenous RNA control.
Calculate N-fold differences in target gene expression (NTARGET) using the formula NTARGET = 2^ΔCt, where ΔCt = Ct(TBP) - Ct(target gene).
Verify the specificity of PCR amplicons using agarose gel electrophoresis.
